name: Active
documentation: Authoritative composite alarm decision reported by the ZMon measurement engine at the relay/beacon control branch; not recomputed by OPC UA.

alarms.name: Ground Fault
alarms.notes: Authoritative composite alarm emitted by the GIZMo ZMon engine; Ignition does not recompute resistance or phase rules.

name: LatchTime
documentation: Time recorded when the persistent latch was set.

name: Latched
documentation: True when the persistent GIZMo alarm latch is set.

name: Reason
documentation: Alarm reason reported directly by the ZMon measurement engine, or empty when the composite alarm is clear.
